in_sanskrit.name: अमलेश
in_sanskrit.meaning: The one who nourishes and sticks to us
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The immortal one who attaches to us

in_hindi.name: अमलेश
in_hindi.meaning: अमेरात का पति, माता का पति, अपना, अपनी
in_hindi.long_meaning: The husband of the goddess Amrita, the husband of the mother, our own, our own

in_tamil.name: அமலேஷ
in_tamil.meaning: அம்மாவின் அருவியல் பெரிய அல்லது அவர்களுக்கான அல்லது இந்தரிய அளவுக்கு இருக்கும் அவர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who nourishes and stays with us, or the one who is attached to them and stays with us

in_telugu.name: అమలేష
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who nourishes and stays with us, the lord of our mother, the immortal one

in_marathi.name: Amalesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the World
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amalesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Amalesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the combination of two words: 'Ama' meaning 'Lord' and 'Resh' meaning 'World'. This name signifies the one who rules over the entire universe. It is a powerful and auspicious name often given to boys in Hindu traditions.
